sections.title: Overview
sections.content: Energising Attack I is a Pictos in Clair Obscur: Expedition 33. Effect: +1 AP on Base Attack.

sections.title: How to Get Energising Attack I
sections.content: Location: Yellow Harvest; Sacred River merchant; Renoir's Drafts merchant.

sections.title: Is It Worth Equipping?
sections.content: Pictos unlock a Lumina after four battles, so equipping it once is enough to keep the effect permanently available for the Lumina cost.
